content.text: {"answer":"Tier 1","citations":["D033","D042","D061","D002","D029","D115"],"explanation":"The signed affiliate amendment (D033) changed Marrow Agrisupply's support SLA from the MSA's Tier 2 (D029) to Tier 1, effective 2025-10-15. The 2026-04-22 renewal (D042) expressly left Marrow Agrisupply's SLA as set by that amendment, so the informal May 2026 note claiming Tier 2 (D115) does not override the signed contracts."}
